g.text: M2: does fresh-activation pacing improve corrected batching?
48 screening runs, 80 requests/run; four finite waves. Bars: two-run means; dots: individual server-start repeats.
Same token-VTC and state8 budget. This is exploratory evidence, not a steady-state or fairness guarantee.
